# Starter DS

> A small React design system. Import everything from `@ds`. Only the exports listed on this page exist.

## Docs

- [All components](llms-components.txt): props, examples and Do/Don't for every component in one file
- [Tokens](llms-tokens.txt): every color, space, radius and font size token

## Components

- [Button](components/button.md): Triggers an action, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.
- [Stack](components/stack.md): Lays out children in a row or column with consistent spacing between them. `Stack` is the only layout primitive in this design system.
- [TextField](components/textfield.md): A single-line text input with a built-in label and error message.

## Exports

This is the complete list of what `@ds` exports.

- Components: `Button`, `Stack`, `TextField`
- Functions: `token`
- Types: `ButtonProps`, `SpaceToken`, `StackProps`, `TextFieldProps`, `TokenPath`

## Not exported

- `Box` does not exist. Use `Stack`.
- `Container` does not exist. Use `Stack`.
- `Flex` does not exist. Use `Stack`.
- `Grid` does not exist. Use `Stack`.
